A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Gadolinium (가돌리늄) itself — the sovereign of the Gadolinium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a soft, gentle warmth; fair skin; gently long oval face; medium-sized eyes — long monolid eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward; soft rounded brows; small button nose; small bow lips; azure-blue eyes; rosy flushed cheeks.
Body and hair: slender-limbed yet full-busted with rounded hips and a narrow waist build; a bob with center-parted bangs framing the face; cool silver hair with a faint rosy warmth at the roots that cools to icy pale blue at the tips.
Expression: a quiet, thoughtful look, lips lightly closed.
Her element, carried in her design: gadolinium: a silvery-white rare-earth metal named through the black mineral gadolinite for a Finnish chemist, first seen in 1880 and named in 1886; it is magnetic like iron only when cool and lets go just above room temperature, around 20 degrees; it warms as it is pulled into a magnet and chills when released, the heart of magnetic refrigeration; it brightens the body's water in MRI scans and captures neutrons better than any other stable element.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Cool silver-white armor with frost-blue edges and a large magnetic cooling unit worn on her back rising above her head, a silver wheel turning between two curved magnet arms inside it and breathing faint cold mist, faint warm-rose seams where the plates run warmest, a bright white scan-ring core at the chest; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: a large equipment unit worn on the back (tanks, a cannon barrel or antennae) rising above her head as the main shape, with medium body armor. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: cool silver-white, frost blue, faint warm rose, scan black and bright white.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a desert city cooled by magnets: great halls of silver gadolinium wheels turning in and out of magnetic fields, warming and chilling with each turn, cool air flowing through white-domed streets, walls of neutron-catching shield panels around the power core.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Gd) and atomic number (64) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
